coordinate_authority: Existing Peugeot405 source body, wheelbase266.9cm; photos provide proportions and design, not calibrated photogrammetry.

kits.name: Gutmann interpretation
kits.observed: Four rectangular foglights, shallow central trapezoid, five apron slots, straight period bands, concave skirts, restrained rear apron.
kits.adaptation: Retains Juiced stock upper bumper/plate, lights, wheel arches and left exhaust. No claimed exact commercial-kit replica.

kits.name: Stratos interpretation
kits.observed: Three large tapered rounded front openings, thin curved bridges, smooth skirts, two low rear recesses.
kits.adaptation: Photo's twin central exhaust replaced with actual left-side engine exhaust clearance. Catalogue upper bumper seams stay.

kits.name: Blue Morette showcase interpretation
kits.observed: Single shallow central opening, four round foglights, outer ducts, double lower lip, centred tapered bonnet scoop.
kits.adaptation: Unidentified body-kit maker. Morette is the photo/headlight source, not a claim about kit manufacturer. Rear not shown: original clean adaptation. Stock Juiced headlights retained.

hoods: Factory pressing and original supplied normals retained; plain carbon and painted/carbon central scoops. Old paired rectangular louvres removed. Scoop is derived from the blue photo and fitted within the existing centre panel.
limitations: Photo-derived game-scale interpretations, not laser scans. Existing opaque glazing hides the source model's incomplete cabin. Existing native vinyl receiver faces retained. No renderer/physics modifications.
